- Checking, analyzing, and processing transportation and planning data
- Identifying delays or irregularities and coordinating with the relevant stakeholders

- A minimum MBO Level 4 working and thinking level (or equivalent vocational qualification)
- Strong administrative and digital skills
- Experience with Microsoft Excel

Within this role, you will operate machinery and also supervise production staff working alongside you on the line. You will do this in English.

- Set up and adjust the net clipper or flowpack machines (performing light technical tasks).
- Supervise production workers.
- Ensure the smooth operation of the production line.
- Troubleshoot and resolve any issues that may arise.
- Perform administrative tasks on a computer to ensure all records and registrations are accurately maintained.

- Experience as an operator in an AGF environment, preferably with experience in using a net clipper or flowpack machine.

- Leadership qualities.
- Full-time availability, preference for a permanent position.
- Own transportation is essential.
- Living near the Rotterdam, The Hague, Zoetermeer, Bleiswijk area.

As an orderpicker / warehouse worker, you make sure that all orders are collected accurately and neatly. Using a handheld scanner or picking list, you move through the warehouse and collect the correct products.

As a logistics employee at Samsung SDS in Breda, you will help get products from Samsung and other companies to the right place. You work in a team where there are regular staff meetings to get to know each other better.

Your tasks depend on the position. Primarily your tasks will be physical, so you need to be physicaly fit. You might be packing and preparing products like microwaves and tv's for shipment. Or you might be loading and unloading containers either with forklift or manually.

You will work two shifts: early (6 a.m. to 3.00 p.m.) or late (3.00 p.m. to 0.00 p.m.).

You will work between 30 and 40 hours per week. 

Do you want to contribute to Samsung's success? Then apply now!

You enjoy working in an international environment and love to work hard. At Samsung SDS, you'll help keep everything running smoothly in the warehouse.

What you bring:

- You have your own transportation to get to work. When you work in shifts, public transport is not possible
- You speak good English, which is helpful in this international environment.
- You are available full-time
- You are fit enough for physical work.
- You have your own accommodation.

It is nice if you are flexible. Sometimes we work overtime or on weekends. But don't worry, that doesn't happen every week!

For a leading high-tech company in Eindhoven, we are looking for an accurate and motivated Cleanroom Precision Operator. In this role, you are responsible for processing valuable industrial components in a controlled cleanroom environment where quality, precision, and safety are the highest priorities.

Your daily responsibilities include:

- Cleaning high-tech components according to strict cleanroom procedures and work instructions.
- Performing assembly and packaging activities using approved materials and tools.
- Inspecting products with measuring equipment and carrying out quality checks.
- Reading and following technical drawings and detailed work instructions.
- Registering inspection results and production data in the quality system.
- Identifying and reporting deviations during the production process.
- Keeping the cleanroom and workplace clean, safe, and organized.

Working hours

You will work Monday through Friday in day shifts between 07:00 and 18:00.

- Minimum of 1 year experience in cleanroom, production, or assembly work
- Good command of the English language
- Ability to read and understand technical drawings
- Accurate and independent working attitude
- Willingness to work according to strict procedures and quality guidelines

Preferred

- Experience cleaning high-tech components
- Experience with quality measurements and measuring equipment

Do you want to put your forklift experience to use at our client DHL Freight in Eindhoven? Then this is your chance!
We are currently looking for a Forklift driver to join the team. In this role you will work in a dynamic logistics environment where accuracy and teamwork are key.

Your main tasks include:

- Loading and unloading trucks
- Operating a forklift safely and efficiently
- Weighing pallets
- Checking and verifying orders
- Ensuring goods are processed correctly and on time

Do you have forklift experience and are you available full-time in 2 shifts (07:30 – 16:00 and 16:00 – 00:30)? Then we would love to hear from you!

Requirements:

- Valid forklift certificate
- Minimum 6 months of experience as a forklift driver
- Good command of Dutch and/or English
- Full-time availability in a shift system

As an Assembly Employee, you are responsible for assembling plastic protection materials for high-tech products. You work accurately based on technical drawings and continuously check the quality of the final product.

Your tasks include:

- Assembling plastic components according to technical drawings
- Performing quality checks on dimensions and finishing
- Checking tolerances and product specifications
- Reporting deviations and improvement opportunities
- Processing and handling plastic materials
- Working together with colleagues from production and logistics
- Maintaining a clean and safe workplace

You will work in a 2-shift schedule with the following working hours:

- 06:00 - 15:00
- 15:00 - 00:00

You will receive additional compensation for weekend overtime.

For this position, we are looking for someone with technical insight and experience within a production environment.

Important requirements:

- Experience with plastic processing or plastic welding
- Ability to read technical drawings
- Willingness to work in a 2-shift schedule
- Good command of the English language
- Accurate and quality-focused work attitude
- Able to work well in a team
